Override.AttributionNote: Complete Record of Chan Master Jifei (即非禪師全錄), portrait praise for Chan Master Xuefeng Jifei (雪峰即非禪師道影讚). Zheng Puyuan is the exact author, identified by the signature 三山弟子鄭溥元熏沐拜題 immediately after the praise. He says Jifei Ruyi possessed Linji Yixuan's responsive operation without indiscriminate blows and shouts and Dahui Zonggao's sweep without empty speech, then names Jifei as Yinyuan Longqi's direct heir and Feiyin Tongrong's true dharma-grandson. Xuefeng here is Jifei's mountain title, not Xuefeng Yicun and not the speaker.
